question: Playing It My Way : My Autobiography, is the book written by whom among the following cricketers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sachin Tendulkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Sachin Tendulkar** is one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.

• He is often referred to as the "God of Cricket" for his numerous records and achievements in the sport.

• His autobiography, "**Playing It My Way**", was released on 5th November 2014.

• The book details his cricketing journey, from his debut as a 16-year-old to his retirement in 2013.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Autobiography:**

• An autobiography is a self-written account of the life of oneself. It provides an insight into the personal experiences and significant events in the life of the author.

• Autobiographies are often written by individuals who have made a significant impact in their respective fields, providing inspiration and detailed accounts of their journeys.

• **Sachin Tendulkar:**

• Sachin Ramesh Tendulkar is a former Indian cricketer and captain, widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.

• He is the highest run-scorer of all time in International cricket, having scored more than 34,000 runs.

• Tendulkar was the first player to score 100 international centuries, and the first to complete more than 30,000 runs in international cricket.

• He received numerous awards, including the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award.

• **Other Cricketers Mentioned:**

• **Kapil Dev:** Former captain of the Indian cricket team, he led India to its first World Cup win in 1983.

• **Rahul Dravid:** Known as "The Wall" of Indian cricket, Dravid is one of the most respected cricketers and has scored over 24,000 runs in international cricket.

• **Virat Kohli:** Current Indian cricketer and one of the leading batsmen in the world, known for his aggressive batting style and consistency.
